description: Guest side of the Incus agent for contemper-built VM images: copies the agent from the share Incus attaches and starts it, under systemd or OpenRC.

variants.name: openrc
variants.description: OpenRC integration for the Incus agent: a supervised init.d service, enabled in the default runlevel, that skips itself outside Incus.

variants.name: systemd
variants.description: systemd integration for the Incus agent: a unit started by a udev rule when the Incus virtio port appears.
